stem: What do both the selection from The Boston Girl and the poem “Sybil Ludington’s Ride” indicate about the young women?

options.label: F
options.text: The young women are courageous in dangerous situations.

options.label: G
options.text: The young women wish to improve their communities.

options.label: H
options.text: The potential of the young women should be recognized.

options.label: J
options.text: The enthusiasm of the young women can be overwhelming.
